# Policymaker #407, iteration 0072

The two design tasks of iteration 0071 merged. Each task needs one independent review before the Policymaker pins its files.

- #404 (codex GPT, 886k input, near the 800k ceiling) added the typedef-impact and diagram-difference case designs in `benchmark/change-cases/` and `benchmark/scripts/change_cases.py`.
- #405 (codex GPT, 391k input) added the repetition, precision and quota plan in `benchmark/precision/` and `benchmark/scripts/precision_plan.py`.
- I ran the checks on main 83e5047. `change_cases.py --check`, `precision_plan.py --check` and `policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` gave exit 0. `benchmark/preparation.json` has sha256 ccff5e0e… and did not change. The new files are not pinned yet.
- Review #403 gave the corrected Owner request draft for method acceptance. I did not file it yet because the two new designs have no independent review.

## Orders (wake false, parallel, from main)

| Order | Expected gain | Check by next session |
|---|---|---|
| `review-change-cases-404` (reviewer, medium, 50 min/35 turns) | Verdict to pin the change-case files under the tasks milestone | `verdict:` line, numbered findings, revert-proof probes |
| `review-precision-plan-405` (reviewer, medium, 45 min/30 turns) | Verdict to pin the precision plan under the baseline milestone | `verdict:` line, 19-field cross-check, probes |

Missing coverage stays visible: zero native executions, 23 unresolved native slots, no split allocation, #169 not ready, and store record #379 pending. Quality is not measured. Quota is an owner decision.

## What next

- If both reviews accept, write one hash-gated pin script and order one run from main (max_turns >= 25). Then file the #403 corrected draft as a `question` with the new commit and the new index hash.
- If a review gives revise, fix with a Policymaker script. Do not order a blind re-review.
- Do not repeat the #400 map or the #403 review. Both authors are GPT family, so prefer a Claude reviewer. Read the `models` block of each review.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
